"import csv
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN

# Read CSV data
data = []
with open('perf_01.csv', 'r') as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in reader:
        data.append(row)

print("Raw data:")
for row in data:
    print(row)

# Extract numeric values
configs = [row['config'] for row in data]
cl_max = [float(row['cl_max']) for row in data]
cd_cruise = [float(row['cd_cruise']) for row in data]
ld_ratio = [float(row['ld_ratio']) for row in data]

# Compute statistics
cl_max_max = max(cl_max)
cd_cruise_mean = sum(cd_cruise) / len(cd_cruise)
ld_ratio_mean = sum(ld_ratio) / len(ld_ratio)
best_ld_idx = ld_ratio.index(max(ld_ratio))
best_config = configs[best_ld_idx]

print(f"\nCLmax max = {cl_max_max}")
print(f"CDcruise mean = {cd_cruise_mean}")
print(f"L/D mean = {ld_ratio_mean}")
print(f"best config = {best_config}")

# Round display values
cl_max_max_display = round(cl_max_max, 3)  # 0.545
cd_cruise_mean_display = round(cd_cruise_mean, 4)  # 0.0313
ld_ratio_mean_display = round(ld_ratio_mean, 1)  # 16.3

print(f"\nDisplay: CLmax={cl_max_max_display}, CDcruise={cd_cruise_mean_display}, L/D={ld_ratio_mean_display}")"
